description.p: This is a community package of Keydeck, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the Bramble Office project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release (the AppImage) unmodified. Updates come through Flatpak, so the app's own update check is turned off.
Keydeck makes and plays slideshows. It opens and saves Keynote files, and opens and exports PowerPoint presentations.
Build slides from themes, text, shapes, charts, tables, pictures, audio and video, add transitions and builds, and present with a presenter display, notes and a timer.

Permissions: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback); the GPU device; sound, for slide audio and video, and narration for Record Slideshow; network access, for web videos and Help > Update Video Support, which downloads yt-dlp to play them. There is no access to your files: Open, Save and Insert go through the system file chooser, and a file opened from the file manager is passed in by it.
Features that run a program the Flatpak runtime doesn't include are unavailable: Equations (they need pdflatex and pdftoppm) and Speak.
